dedupe_keys.name: iec 60870 5 104 scada intrusion detection dataset electricity distribution testbed traffic with scan brute force and flood attacks

description: This dataset records SCADA traffic under the IEC 60870-5-104 protocol from a testbed that simulates an electricity distribution process, built by Arifin, Stiawan, Susanto, Budiarto and Idris. The Zenodo record, deposited in 2022, explains that distribution SCADA is exposed because it sits in community settings and RTUs have limited resources; normal communication between the HMI and RTU was recorded and then attacked with port scans, brute force and denial of service by ICMP flood, SYN flood and a modified IEC 104 flood that sends unknown type-ID ASDUs to the RTU, using Kali Linux. All scenarios are saved as PCAP, and Snort and Suricata were used to confirm the attack traffic. The 2024 IEEE Access paper describes the hybrid virtual-physical testbed, adds Xmas scans and compares six machine learning IDS models, with decision tree and random forest reaching 93.66 percent accuracy. The Zenodo files are restricted, so access must be requested from the authors; there is no charge and the paper is open access. Coverage is one testbed. Caveats: testbed traffic, not utility captures, and file sizes and terms were not visible. Simulation uses are training intrusion detection for distribution SCADA and testing cyber-physical resilience scenarios. Related records: data-iec61850-goose-security-dataset-adsc covers IEC 61850 substation traffic.
